renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Use ONLY the claims in the ESSENCE list below; every paragraph must correspond to at least one essence item (record indices). Do not add doctrines, comparisons, meta-commentary, or quoted terms. ESSENCE: [0] The song establishes devotion without preparatory rule as valid, then proves it: since all beings desire the self and the self alone is consciousness, love directed at it stands on its own nature and needs no external ground. | [1] Knowing this by immersion is itself the conquest. | [2] The remaining verses draw the consequences — the world becomes ritual ground, every road works, localization of the goal in special states is the one deceit — and close by transfiguring the opening image: the dust-greyed mind, watered by devotion, fruits liberation.

paragraphs.text: You don't need to do special homework before you are allowed to love God. Why? Because what you love is your own deepest self — you already want it, the way you already want to be happy. Nothing extra has to happen first.
And just getting this — really soaking in it, not just hearing it — is already the win. There is no second step.

Once that clicks, everything else follows: the whole world turns into your prayer mat, every path works, and the only lie is thinking God lives only in some special place or time. Even your tired, dusty mind can bloom if you keep watering it with love.

renders.prompt: Render the argument of this song in a Gen-Z voice: direct, a little feral, zero cringe, no slang overload. Keep every doctrinal claim intact — voice changes, content does not. No new doctrines, no comparisons, no meta-commentary, no quoted terms.

paragraphs.text: No prerequisites. You don't have to clean yourself up, learn the ritual, or wait until you're worthy before you're allowed to love God — because what you're loving is your own self, and wanting yourself is just default settings. No ground needed because there's nowhere else to stand.
And actually getting that — in your body, not as a fact you memorized — is already the whole win. Soak over study.

After that everything flips: the world is the temple now, every road counts, and the only scam is thinking God clocks in only at special times and places. Your dusty, busted-up mind? Water it with this and it fruits.
